relations.note: Attests that the Betsche estates were conferred 'durch die Schenkungs Urkunde von 10ten Juny 1797'. The day is written 10 here where every other copy in this holding reads the 19th. Ruled by the editor, 2026-09-17: an error in the original document, not a misreading, and left standing.
And by 'deren Deklarezion von des izt regierenden Königl. Majestaat vom 1ten December ejd: a.' - document 11.

text:
Wir Friedrich Wilhelm Gottes Gnaden
König von Preußen
Thun kund und fügen hiermit zu wißen, daß
die Betscher Güter Meseritzer Creises
dem regierenden Herrn Fürsten Frie¬
drich Ludwig zu Hohenlohe Ingelfin¬
gen von des Höchst Seeligen Königs Maje¬
staet durch die Schenkungs Urkunde von
10ten Juny 1797. und deren Deklarezion
von des izt regierenden Königl. Maje¬
staat vom 1ten December ejd: a. würklich
verliehen sind, daß die Berichtigung
des Besitz Tituls des gedachten Herrn
Fürsten sich nur ander vom Fisco
noch zu leistenden Resignation accro¬
chiret, daß diese Betscher Güter ehe¬
mals geistliche, nehmlich zum Bistum
Posen gehörige Güter gewesen sind
und daß darauf bis izt von dem be¬
nannten Herrn Fürsten keine
schulden kontrahirt und keine Schuld
Dokumente zur Ingrossation ein¬
gereicht worden sind,
als worüber Wir dem Herrn Fürsten
zu Hohenlohe auf deßen Ansinnen vom
heutigen Tage gegenwärtiges Attest hierdurch
haben erteilen laßen. Urkundlich unter
Unserer Süd Preußischen Regierung größern
Insiegel und gewönlichen Unterschrift. Gege¬
ben Posen den 9ten Februar 1802.
Steudener
Fest.
Attest
für den regierenden
Herrn Fürsten zu
Hohenlohe Ingelfingen
aus den Betscher Grü[?]
und Hypotheken Acten.

translation.en:
We Friedrich Wilhelm, by God's Grace King of Prussia, do hereby make known and give to be understood, that the Betsche estates in the district of Meseritz have been actually conferred upon the reigning Prince Friedrich Ludwig of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen by His Majesty the late King of most blessed memory, through the deed of donation of 10 June 1797 and the declaration thereof by the now reigning Royal Majesty of 1 December of the same year; that the settling of the said Prince's title of possession depends only upon the resignation still to be furnished by the Treasury; that these Betsche estates were formerly ecclesiastical estates, namely estates belonging to the bishopric of Posen; and that up to the present no debts have been contracted upon them by the said Prince, and no instruments of debt have been submitted for registration; concerning all which We have caused the present attestation to be issued hereby to the Prince of Hohenlohe upon his request of this day's date. In witness whereof, under the greater seal of Our South Prussian Government and the customary signature. Given at Posen, 9 February 1802. Steudener

Fest.

Attestation for the reigning Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen out of the Betsche land[illegible] and mortgage records.

We Friedrich Wilhelm, by God's Grace King of Prussia, do hereby make known and give to be understood, that the Betsche estates in the district of Meseritz have been actually conferred upon the reigning Prince Friedrich Ludwig of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen by His Majesty the late King of most blessed memory, through the deed of donation of 10 June 1797 and the declaration thereof by the now reigning Royal Majesty of 1 December of the same year; that the settling of the said Prince's title of possession depends only upon the resignation still to be furnished by the Treasury; that these Betsche estates were formerly ecclesiastical estates, namely estates belonging to the bishopric of Posen; and that up to the present no debts have been contracted upon them by the said Prince, and no instruments of debt have been submitted for registration; concerning all which We have caused the present attestation to be issued hereby to the Prince of Hohenlohe upon his request of this day's date. In witness whereof, under the greater seal of Our South Prussian Government and the customary signature. Given at Posen, 9 February 1802. Steudener

Fest.

summary_en: A royal attestation, made out at the Prince's request from the Betsche land and mortgage records, certifying that the Betsche estates in the district of Meseritz were conferred on the reigning Prince Friedrich Ludwig of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen by a deed of donation of 10 June 1797 and a declaration of 1 December that year; that only the Treasury's resignation is still wanted to settle his title; that the estates formerly belonged to the bishopric of Posen; and that he has registered no debts upon them.
summary_de: Eine Bescheinigung der südpreußischen Regierung aus den Betscher Land- und Hypothekenbüchern: Die Güter Betsche im Kreis Meseritz seien dem regierenden Fürsten Friedrich Ludwig von Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen durch Schenkungsurkunde vom 10. Juni 1797 und Erklärung vom 1. Dezember desselben Jahres verliehen worden; die Eintragung seines Besitztitels hänge nur noch an der vom Fiskus zu leistenden Resignation. Betsche sei früher geistliches Gut des Bistums Posen gewesen; Schulden habe der Fürst darauf bisher nicht aufgenommen, Schuldurkunden seien nicht zur Eintragung eingereicht. Unterzeichnet Steudener.
